name: Workday HCM
summary: Workday Human Capital Management is an enterprise HR system built around Core HCM, with absence management inside Workforce Management and analytics and reporting on top. The product page shows no prices and directs buyers to Contact Sales or a demo.

facts.text: The product page describes Core HCM as a foundation for HR data, and says absence needs for a global workforce are managed in Workforce Management.
Contact Sales and Request a Demo buttons appear on the vendor's page, with no dollar figures.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: Contact Sales or request a demo

hiddenCosts: No prices, minimums or contract terms are published on the product page.
